import React from "react";
import { Box, Button, Typography, Grid } from "@mui/material";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Helmet } from "react-helmet";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ZB_COLORS } from "./theme";

const features = [
  {
    icon: "🧪",
    title: "Simulations",
    desc: "Dive into real-world scenarios across fintech, agritech, healthcare, and more.",
    to: "/simulations",
  },
  {
    icon: "💬",
    title: "Forum",
    desc: "Publish articles, debate ideas, and connect with like-minded professionals.",
    to: "/forum",
  },
  {
    icon: "🎙️",
    title: "Podcasts",
    desc: "Listen to in-depth discussions to stay informed and inspired on the go.",
    to: "/podcast",
  },
  {
    icon: "📚",
    title: "Library",
    desc: "Access a rich catalogue of curated resources to upskill and stay ahead.",
    to: "/library",
  },
];

const quotes = [
  { text: "The more you learn, the more you earn.", author: "Warren Buffett" },
  { text: "The power which establishes a strong career is the same power that builds a strong character.", author: "Kenneth Kaunda" },
  { text: "Commit to lifelong learning. The most valuable asset you'll ever have is your mind.", author: "Brian Tracy" },
];

const stats = [
  { num: "12+", label: "Simulations" },
  { num: "Free", label: "To join" },
  { num: "5+", label: "Industries" },
];

const fadeUp = (delay = 0) => ({
  initial: { opacity: 0, y: 24 },
  animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
  transition: { duration: 0.55, delay, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] },
});

export default function Home({ isLoggedIn }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Helmet>
        <title>ZBRIDGE — Bridge the Gap</title>
      </Helmet>

      {/* HERO */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: "relative",
          overflow: "hidden",
          pt: { xs: 6, md: 9 },
          pb: { xs: 5, md: 7 },
          px: { xs: 2, md: 4 },
          textAlign: "center",
          background: ZB_COLORS.navy,
          "&::before": {
            content: '""',
            position: "absolute",
            top: -120, left: "50%", transform: "translateX(-50%)",
            width: 700, height: 500,
            background: "radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(26,35,126,0.45) 0%, transparent 68%)",
            pointerEvents: "none",
          },
        }}
      >
        <motion.div {...fadeUp(0)}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: "inline-block",
              background: "rgba(255,214,0,0.12)",
              color: ZB_COLORS.gold,
              border: "0.5px solid rgba(255,214,0,0.3)",
              fontSize: "0.72rem",
              fontWeight: 600,
              px: 2, py: 0.5,
              borderRadius: "20px",
              letterSpacing: "0.07em",
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              mb: 2.5,
              fontFamily: "DM Sans",
            }}
          >
            For Students & Professionals in Zambia
          </Box>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div {...fadeUp(0.1)}>
          <Typography
            variant="h1"
            sx={{
              fontSize: { xs: "2.2rem", md: "3.5rem" },
              fontWeight: 700,
              color: "#fff",
              lineHeight: 1.12,
              letterSpacing: "-0.03em",
              maxWidth: 720,
              mx: "auto",
              mb: 2,
            }}
          >
            Bridge the gap between{" "}
            <Box component="span" sx={{ color: ZB_COLORS.gold }}>learning</Box>{" "}
            and doing
          </Typography>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div {...fadeUp(0.2)}>
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: { xs: "1rem", md: "1.1rem" },
              color: ZB_COLORS.textMuted,
              maxWidth: 540, mx: "auto", mb: 3.5,
              fontFamily: "DM Sans",
            }}
          >
            ZBRIDGE connects you with real-world simulations, expert resources, and a
            community to accelerate your career in Africa.
          </Typography>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div {...fadeUp(0.3)}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 1.5, justifyContent: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <Button
              component={Link}
              to={isLoggedIn ? "/simulations" : "/profile"}
              variant="contained"
              size="large"
              sx={{ px: 3.5, py: 1.2, fontSize: "0.95rem" }}
            >
              {isLoggedIn ? "Browse simulations" : "Get started free"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              component={Link}
              to="/about"
              size="large"
              sx={{
                px: 3, py: 1.2, fontSize: "0.95rem",
                color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)",
                border: "0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
                borderRadius: "8px",
                "&:hover": { border: "0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4)", color: "#fff", background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" },
              }}
            >
              Learn more →
            </Button>
          </Box>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Stats bar */}
        <motion.div {...fadeUp(0.45)}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: "grid",
              gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${stats.length}, 1fr)`,
              gap: "1px",
              background: ZB_COLORS.border,
              maxWidth: 480,
              mx: "auto",
              mt: 6,
              borderRadius: "12px",
              overflow: "hidden",
              border: `0.5px solid ${ZB_COLORS.border}`,
            }}
          >
            {stats.map((s) => (
              <Box key={s.label} sx={{ background: ZB_COLORS.navy, py: 2, textAlign: "center" }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontFamily: "Sora", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "1.6rem", color: ZB_COLORS.gold }}>
                  {s.num}
                </Typography>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: "0.72rem", color: ZB_COLORS.textMuted, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.06em", fontFamily: "DM Sans" }}>
                  {s.label}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            ))}
          </Box>
        </motion.div>
      </Box>

      {/* FEATURES */}
      <Box sx={{ px: { xs: 2, md: 4 }, py: { xs: 5, md: 7 }, maxWidth: 1100, mx: "auto" }}>
        <motion.div {...fadeUp(0)}>
          <Typography
            sx={{ fontSize: "0.72rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.1em", color: ZB_COLORS.gold, fontWeight: 600, mb: 1, fontFamily: "DM Sans" }}
          >
            What's on ZBRIDGE
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="h2" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: "1.8rem", md: "2.25rem" }, color: "#fff", mb: 1 }}>
            Everything you need to grow
          </Typography>
          <Typography sx={{ color: ZB_COLORS.textMuted, mb: 4, maxWidth: 480, fontFamily: "DM Sans" }}>
            From hands-on simulations to curated resources — built for the Zambian professional.
          </Typography>
        </motion.div>

        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          {features.map((f, i) => (
            <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} md={3} key={f.title}>
              <motion.div {...fadeUp(i * 0.08)}>
                <Box
                  component={Link}
                  to={f.to}
                  sx={{
                    display: "block",
                    textDecoration: "none",
                    background: ZB_COLORS.cardBg,
                    border: `0.5px solid ${ZB_COLORS.border}`,
                    borderRadius: "12px",
                    p: 2.5,
                    height: "100%",
                    transition: "all 0.2s ease",
                    "&:hover": {
                      background: ZB_COLORS.cardHover,
                      borderColor: "rgba(255,214,0,0.3)",
                      transform: "translateY(-3px)",
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  <Box sx={{ fontSize: "1.75rem", mb: 1.5 }}>{f.icon}</Box>
                  <Typography sx={{ fontFamily: "Sora", fontWeight: 600, color: "#fff", mb: 0.75, fontSize: "1rem" }}>
                    {f.title}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography sx={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", color: ZB_COLORS.textMuted, fontFamily: "DM Sans", lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                    {f.desc}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              </motion.div>
            </Grid>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Box>

      {/* ABOUT BAND */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          background: "rgba(26,35,126,0.25)",
          borderTop: `0.5px solid ${ZB_COLORS.border}`,
          borderBottom: `0.5px solid ${ZB_COLORS.border}`,
          px: { xs: 2, md: 8 }, py: { xs: 5, md: 6 },
          textAlign: "center",
        }}
      >
        <Typography variant="h3" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: "1.5rem", md: "2rem" }, color: "#fff", mb: 2 }}>
          What is ZBRIDGE?
        </Typography>
        <Typography sx={{ color: ZB_COLORS.textMuted, maxWidth: 660, mx: "auto", fontFamily: "DM Sans", fontSize: "1rem" }}>
          ZBRIDGE is a career-readiness platform that transforms education into action. Through industry-inspired
          simulations and guided reflections, we help students and young professionals build real skills, explore
          career paths, and stand out in a competitive world — all before their first job.
        </Typography>
        <Button
          component={Link} to="/about"
          sx={{
            mt: 3, color: ZB_COLORS.gold,
            border: `0.5px solid ${ZB_COLORS.gold}`,
            borderRadius: "8px", px: 2.5, py: 0.75,
            fontSize: "0.875rem",
            "&:hover": { background: "rgba(255,214,0,0.08)" },
          }}
        >
          Read our story
        </Button>
      </Box>

      {/* QUOTES */}
      <Box sx={{ px: { xs: 2, md: 4 }, py: { xs: 5, md: 7 }, maxWidth: 1100, mx: "auto" }}>
        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: "0.72rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.1em", color: ZB_COLORS.gold, fontWeight: 600, mb: 1, fontFamily: "DM Sans" }}>
          Words of Wisdom
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="h3" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: "1.5rem", md: "2rem" }, color: "#fff", mb: 3 }}>
          Stay inspired
        </Typography>
        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          {quotes.map((q, i) => (
            <Grid item xs={12} md={4} key={i}>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  background: ZB_COLORS.cardBg,
                  border: `0.5px solid ${ZB_COLORS.border}`,
                  borderRadius: "12px", p: 3,
                  position: "relative", height: "100%",
                }}
              >
                <Typography sx={{ fontFamily: "Sora", fontSize: "3rem", lineHeight: 1, color: ZB_COLORS.gold, opacity: 0.35, mb: 1 }}>
                  "
                </Typography>
                <Typography sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)", fontFamily: "DM Sans", fontSize: "0.9rem", lineHeight: 1.65, mb: 1.5 }}>
                  {q.text}
                </Typography>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", fontWeight: 600, color: ZB_COLORS.gold, fontFamily: "DM Sans" }}>
                  — {q.author}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Grid>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Box>

      {/* CTA BANNER */}
      <Box sx={{ px: { xs: 2, md: 4 }, pb: { xs: 5, md: 7 } }}>
        <Box
          sx={{
            background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1a237e 0%, #0d47a1 100%)",
            borderRadius: "16px",
            border: `0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`,
            p: { xs: 3.5, md: 5 },
            textAlign: "center",
            maxWidth: 1100, mx: "auto",
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="h3" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: "1.5rem", md: "2rem" }, color: "#fff", mb: 1.5 }}>
            Ready to start your journey?
          </Typography>
          <Typography sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.65)", fontFamily: "DM Sans", mb: 3 }}>
            Join Zambian students and professionals already using ZBRIDGE to build real-world skills.
          </Typography>
          <Button
            component={Link}
            to="/profile"
            variant="contained"
            size="large"
            sx={{ px: 4, py: 1.3, fontSize: "1rem" }}
          >
            Create your free account
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </>
  );
}
